title: A Whole New World

source.reason: MELODY track contains a clear lead line; E.PIANO 2 provides simplified lower-register support notes.

conversion_notes: Regenerated for the updated physical angklung rack map G3-C6.
The previous A Whole New World draft used a G4-C7 software map and did not activate enough upper physical angklungs after remapping.
Main melody is now pushed into the upper physical register where possible: C5-C6, with G4/A4/B4 lifted to G5/A5/B5.
Notes above C6 from the older software map were folded down one octave to stay inside the G3-C6 rack.
Accompaniment/support notes were moved into the lower physical register: G3-F4.
This remains dense and should be simulator/display testing only until manually simplified.

warnings: The arrangement is dense and may be unsafe for real motors without simplification.
This file is for simulator/display testing; do not mark demo_safe yet.
Global software rack should be updated to G3-C6 before using this file.

arrangement_policy.melody_target_range: C5-C6 preferred; G4/A4/B4 are octave-raised when possible

tracks.description: Upper physical-register melody for G3-C6 rack.
Lower physical-register accompaniment for G3-C6 rack.

summary.not_demo_safe_reason: Dense MIDI-derived layered draft; requires manual simplification and motor-safety review.
